round1: Stephanie led Round 1 with 24 points, the only person to take Montreal over the Capitals, and the only one to nail Chicago in six. Derrick started at the bottom with 12, having picked Washington. Everyone, to be fair, did correctly pick Pittsburgh over Ottawa.
round2: Nickall picked all four winning teams for 15 points, and was the only one to take Montreal over Pittsburgh, nailing it in seven. Marc ended up last in the round at 7, while Derrick was the only one to nail Philadelphia in seven.
round3: Jaclyn led the round with 4 points, which tells you how rough it was. Marc and Nickall both picked Montreal and San Jose and scored nothing, and only Derrick took Philadelphia while only Stephanie took Chicago.
round4: Jaclyn, Marc and Nickall each nailed Chicago in six for 15 points, while Derrick took Chicago in five for 4 and Stephanie backed Philadelphia in six for 5. Jaclyn took the overall lead with the Final result.
overall: Jaclyn won her third pool, her first since 1998, with 49 points, three clear of Nickall (46). Derrick finished last at 33, his fourth time at the bottom. Marc, Derrick and Jaclyn have now all picked the right Cup winner two years in a row, which is a nice change from the droughts.
